['Konica Minolta Business Solutions Euro.company_description: Konica Minolta Business Solutions Europe GmbH, based in Langenhagen, Germany, is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Konica Minolta Inc., Tokyo, Japan, forming part of its Business Technologies business area. The company offers smart IT services & systems, multifunctional devices, professional printing, and managed print services. It has also attained all six Microsoft Cloud Solutions Partner Designations, highlighting its comprehensive capabilities across all Microsoft Cloud Solution areas.

['Bitburger Holding GmbH '].company_description: Bitburger Holding GmbH operates in the consumer goods industry, specifically in the production of premium beer and alcoholic beverages. Additionally, it has been involved in forming joint ventures in the plant-based beverage market and has divested non-healthcare related businesses.
